articles.title: Why Apple is finally making its own smart home devices
articles.essence: For more than a decade, Apple has told other companies to build smart home devices for its platform. This week, Apple launched its own.
articles.full_body: For more than a decade, Apple has told other companies to build smart home devices for its platform. This week, Apple launched its own. The Apple Home Collection is a lineup of cameras, thermostats, sensors, a smart door lock, and a video doorbell, all codeveloped with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric. They arrive alongside HomeView, […]
sentences: For more than a decade, Apple has told other companies to build smart home devices for its platform.
This week, Apple launched its own.
The Apple Home Collection is a lineup of cameras, thermostats, sensors, a smart door lock, and a video doorbell, all codeveloped with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric.

articles.title: The new Apple TV 4K just got its first (very small) discount
articles.essence: Earlier this week, Apple announced its new Apple TV 4K, which costs nearly twice as much as the 2022 model did at launch. Amazon is now offering the first discount on the forthcoming streaming box (coming out on November 13th), just days after discounting Apple’s new smart display for the first time.
